metric_policy.comparison_rule: Only compare snapshots when quality_contract_fingerprint is unchanged.
metric_policy.book_100_rule: Every required category must equal 100 and known_blockers must be empty.
metric_policy.series_score_rule: Series readiness equals the weakest registered book overall automated readiness; averages may not hide a weak book.
metric_policy.series_100_rule: Every registered book must individually satisfy the book_100_rule.
metric_policy.readiness_floor_rule: A book readiness floor equals its weakest required category; it must be 100 before the book can be automated 100/100.
metric_policy.prompt_load_rule: Prompt-load telemetry is observational until a stable successful canary baseline establishes useful bounds; do not reward shorter prompts automatically.
metric_policy.foundation_rule: Foundation Readiness reaches 100 only when runtime, preflight, series audit, active-book structure, and a current same-engine autopilot heartbeat are all healthy.
metric_policy.review_pipeline_rule: Image technical QA measures PNG/print technical checks only. Vision-reviewer software failures are reported separately as review_pipeline_health and must not masquerade as image QA regression.
metric_policy.exact_image_authority_rule: Local vision-review scores are advisory telemetry only. Visual Cleanliness and Semantic Accuracy pass only from a current exact-image approve/select decision; local pass/score/stage may never satisfy a required readiness metric.
metric_policy.print_package_rule: Print Package Readiness requires exact export QA, deterministic safe margin, alternating binding-gutter validation, a configured source-attribution page, generic deterministic assembly, and a reproducible final proof for 100/100.

score_100_requires: new tome created from declared theme and roster through generic manifests and contracts
page recipes generated and validated without engine code edits
monster family and environment story behavior supplied by reusable data rather than creature-name engine branches
technical QA semantic review scoring duplicate detection print safety preview locking and assembly use unchanged paths
synthetic next-tome test uses a runtime probe that proves scaffold promotion manifest validation prompt resolution and pre-GPU lint through universal contracts
master engine separation audit proves core art_pipeline code contains no literal monster IDs, monster names, or production page IDs
replication-critical generation and canary launch scripts resolve active book, canary set, page counts, and manifest paths from configuration without production book/page literals
